### Third John
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/third-john
Passage: 3 John 1:1-4
Points:
- Third John encourages Gaius to support traveling teachers of apostolic truth while cautioning against self-exalting church leaders.
- The wish for Gaius's health follows standard first-century greeting conventions rather than promising universal physical prosperity.
- Christian leaders experience immense joy whenever they see fellow believers walking faithfully in the truth.
- Total bodily and material restoration belongs to the new creation, while spiritual blessings are promised now.
- Believers must learn godly contentment with God's provision even amid hardship and suffering.

### Day 337: 3 John 1–4
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-337-3-john-14.html
Passage: 3 John 1:2
Points:
- Physical exhaustion and poor health directly take a heavy toll on our spiritual and emotional endurance.
- Believers cannot faithfully fulfill their ministries if they neglect to care for their bodies as temples of the Spirit.
- Faithfulness in service requires deliberate cooperation with God by respecting physical limits.
- Regular Sabbath rest, recreation, and refreshment are vital necessities for sustaining long-term ministry.
